reason: I already take magnesium every night at home, so the on-the-go part doesn't solve anything for me. The named lab and batch report are nice, but I'm not switching a bottle I already own for $25 to $30 a month.
objection: I already have magnesium on my counter and I take it at home, so paying more for single sachets I don't need to carry feels pointless.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing a real problem I have, like travel or late nights away from home where I skip my dose, plus a price closer to $15 for the first box.
